newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Cement sales up 22.5 pct yr/yr Jan-Apr in Portugal.
newsitem.headline: Cement sales up 22.5 pct yr/yr Jan-Apr in Portugal.

text.p: Sales of cement in Portugal are estimated to have risen by some 22.5 percent in the first four months of 1997, compared with the same year-ago period, the Association of Construction and Public Works Companies (AECOPS) said.
"The estimates of AECOPS indicate that cement sales in the domestic market were about 850,000 tonnes in April," AECOPS said in a statement.

It added: "If this estimate is confirmed, it implies a year-on-year increase in April of more than 23 percent and an accumulated year-on-year increase (from January to April) of more than 22.5 percent."
AECOPS did not give the value of the accumulated cement sales.
